title: RegisteredClaim
description: A source-derived claim in the claims register (claims-registry pipeline). Claims are authored by deep-read subagents (round 2) from sources, adversarially checked by independent agents fetching the primary source (round 3), and only lifecycle=validated claims may appear as factual premises in the report draft. claim_id is a per-run sequential C-number ('C1', 'C42') used in draft prose as [Cn] markers until mechanical conversion to source citations.

claim_id.description: Per-run sequential id assigned at register aggregation ('C1'..'Cn')

statement.description: One checkable fact or implication, as it would appear in prose

kind.description: status = temporal claim (fork stage, milestone progress, 'currently X') — must use the source's own stage vocabulary and is re-verified at packaging time; quote = the statement IS a quotation and must be verbatim

source_id.description: ID of the backing source in sources.jsonl

source_url.description: Direct URL the checker fetches (kept inline for checker convenience)

evidence_quote.description: VERBATIM passage from the source supporting the statement. Mandatory — this field is the error-killer; paraphrase is not acceptable.

quote_locator.description: Optional section/heading/page locating the quote in the source

provenance_tier.description: Inherited from the source. Aggregator-tier can never back a load-bearing claim; transcription = vision-decoded figure, partially verifiable

fetched_at.description: When the source was fetched/read by the authoring agent

authored_by.description: Authoring subagent/task id (round-2 batch or round-3 checker)

round.description: 2 = authored in deep-read round; 3 = generated by a checker (must itself be checked by a new agent)

lifecycle.description: candidate → validated (checker confirmed) | discarded (refuted, notes required) | superseded (replaced by a corrected claim; keeps audit trail). Claims are never deleted.
